notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The clock in the top bar now reads either way round. It starts as 24-hour; click it to switch to 12-hour, and click it again to switch back. Whichever you pick is remembered and comes back next time.
- The empty preset key now says only "Add station". It used to carry a second line describing the form it opens, which on a crowded row wrapped and made that key taller than the ones beside it.
- That key also sizes its own label to fit its button, so it is no longer cut short on the faces set in a wide display type.
- Enhancements to seasonal themes.

## Bug fixes

- The schedule chip beside the clock no longer steps sideways when the clock changes format, or at noon and midnight.
- The clock takes the keyboard like any other control, and now draws the app's own focus ring rather than the browser's default box.
- Fixes in seasonal themes.
